links.outcome: Weighted accuracy across generic LLM, domain-prompted LLM, and full agent with guideline RAG and tools
links.effect: Weighted accuracy rose from 55.6% (generic LLM) to 66.7% (domain prompting) to 100% (full agent) on 9 synthetic cases; Wilson 95% CI 70.1–100%. Small synthetic set, keyword scoring, no cardiologist adjudication.
links.quote: In a controlled set of nine synthetic cardiovascular cases, weighted accuracy increased from 55.6% for the generic LLM to 66.7% after domain prompting and to 100% with the complete agent.

links.outcome: Numerical consistency checker detection of altered values and handling of anomalous inputs
links.effect: Handled 4 anomalous inputs correctly, verified 9/9 correct numerical claims, and detected 5/5 intentionally altered values.
links.quote: Functional safety checks correctly handled four anomalous inputs, verified nine of nine correct numerical claims, and detected five of five intentionally altered values.

unlisted_practices: Deterministic clinical calculation tools invoked by the LLM agent to replace non-deterministic numerical reasoning

screen.practice: retrieval grounding, deterministic tools, and numerical consistency checking added to LLM
screen.reason: Evaluates the addition of deployment-oriented safeguards (retrieval-augmented generation, deterministic clinical calculation tools, and numerical consistency checkers) compared to baseline generic and domain-prompted LLMs on synthetic cardiovascular clinical decision support cases.

primary.practice: agentic ReAct architecture with guideline RAG, tool calling, and numerical consistency checks
